id: \bGurkinn: Welcome to Geosenge Town. I believe you have met my granddaughter Korrina.
en: \bGurkinn: Welcome to Geosenge Town. I believe you have met my granddaughter Korrina.
it: \bGurkinn: Benvenuto a Cromleburgo. Credo che tu abbia conosciuto mia nipote Ornella.

id: \bShe's an aspiring Trainer. One day she will take over the responsibilities of Mega Evolution. But for now let me tell you about them.
en: \bShe's an aspiring Trainer. One day she will take over the responsibilities of Mega Evolution. But for now let me tell you about them.
it: \bÈ un'Allenatrice promettente. Un giorno si farà carico delle responsabilità legate alla Megaevoluzione. Ma per ora lascia che te ne parli io.

id: \bI don't tell just anyone this stuff. But I see you have a Mega Ring from Sycamore. I told him to give it to a Trainer that he trusts to handle it.
en: \bI don't tell just anyone this stuff. But I see you have a Mega Ring from Sycamore. I told him to give it to a Trainer that he trusts to handle it.
it: \bNon racconto queste cose a chiunque. Ma vedo che hai un Megacerchio di Platan. Gli avevo detto di darlo a un Allenatore di cui si fidasse.

id: \bMega Evolution is a transformation of Pokémon that were thought to be unable to evolve any further! It's a whole new level of power!
en: \bMega Evolution is a transformation of Pokémon that were thought to be unable to evolve any further! It's a whole new level of power!
it: \bLa Megaevoluzione è una trasformazione di Pokémon che si credeva non potessero evolversi ulteriormente! È un livello di potere completamente nuovo!

id: \bThere's a reason why I used the word "transformation" a moment ago. Mega Evolution differs from Evolution because it ends after battle.
en: \bThere's a reason why I used the word "transformation" a moment ago. Mega Evolution differs from Evolution because it ends after battle.
it: \bC'è un motivo per cui poco fa ho usato la parola "trasformazione". La Megaevoluzione è diversa dall'evoluzione perché finisce dopo la lotta.

id: \bTo make Mega Evolution work, you need two items: a Mega Stone for the Pokémon and the Mega Ring.
en: \bTo make Mega Evolution work, you need two items: a Mega Stone for the Pokémon and the Mega Ring.
it: \bPer usare la Megaevoluzione servono due strumenti: una Megapietra per il Pokémon e il Megacerchio.

id: \bThat seems to be it. Let me give you two stones to help you out.
en: \bThat seems to be it. Let me give you two stones to help you out.
it: \bDirei che è tutto. Lascia che ti dia due pietre per darti una mano.

id: \bGurkinn: Use Mega Evolution well. I trust you'll be able to handle it.
en: \bGurkinn: Use Mega Evolution well. I trust you'll be able to handle it.
it: \bGurkinn: Usa bene la Megaevoluzione. Confido che saprai gestirla.

id: \rGeosenge Town has been here for ages. The purpose of it is unknown, but it is believed it served a great purpose.
en: \rGeosenge Town has been here for ages. The purpose of it is unknown, but it is believed it served a great purpose.
it: \rCromleburgo esiste da tempo immemorabile. Il suo scopo è sconosciuto, ma si crede che abbia avuto un ruolo importante.
